versions.changes: New app icon (green mountains with a gold line to the summit) on the program, shortcuts, taskbar and window, and on the profile and PIN screens. Retirement: the margin loan's interest before retirement is added to the loan or paid from your pay (your choice); repaying the loan at retirement shows as a sale with its capital gain in the first year; a fall below the maintenance margin triggers a margin call (holdings sold to repay part of the loan) in the simple results and in Monte Carlo, which also shows how often margin calls happened; a warning when the loan costs more than the holdings earn. Retirement page: narrower input boxes, spending goals are the Fixed Goal policy, and the withdrawal strategy is chosen in the comparison card. Buttons look the same throughout the app. Privacy: the published source zip holds only the program (no tests, sample files or tools), every release is checked for personal data before it is published, and updates delete data files that older source updates left behind.
